newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair sets terms with flight attendants.
newsitem.headline: Swissair sets terms with flight attendants.

text.p: Swissair AG said it had reached agreement with the cabin personnel union Kapers on a three-year contract for around 3,500 flight attendants that will save the company around seven million Swiss francs a year.
Most of the savings stem from making flight duty regulations more flexible, the airline said in a statement. Flight attendants also agreed to reduced compensation for overtime.

In return, management agreed to a three-year contract despite the difficult economic environment, it said. The pact must still be approved by Swissair's board and Kapers rank-and-file members. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
